force_direction_check.metric: mean cosine with the inward radial direction

force_magnitude_check.metric: mean |acc| over surface particles / (sigma/(rho R dx))

criteria: Force points inward for surface particles (mean cosine > 0.5)
Mean acceleration within a factor of 10 of sigma/(rho R dx)
validation.note: Direction and order of magnitude only. The Laplace pressure check is benchmarks/surface_tension/laplace.py; the merged neighbour-count colour model fails the direction criterion (measured mean cosine 0.17), the support_sum model passes.
validation.withdrawal_reason: The recorded PASS used the criterion 'force magnitude is non-zero and physically reasonable', while the same report shows a measured acceleration of 0.5585 m/s2 against an expected scale of 7.2e-4 m/s2 (776x), and an average inward dot product of 0.174 against the module's own stated criterion of 0.5. A model that applies traction two to three orders of magnitude too large is not validated.
validation.laplace_law_note: dp = sigma/R is checked by benchmarks/surface_tension/laplace.py; the merged CSF model is off by +27% to +296% there and does not converge with resolution.
